purpose: noise model for training / evaluating RGB->RAW reconstruction of this camera
dn_domain: BayerRG24 DN of the combined HDR output, pedestal 256 (step 1)
gain_note: digital, applied after HDR combination: alpha and DN noise scale by 10^(g/20), read noise in e- and dark current unchanged
caveat: LUCID exposure limit 800 ms. At 1 s the global black level is bistable (normal vs -9.7 DN, all CFA, random per stream start, can drop mid-stream; found by jsh-3e 2026-10-20); 300/500/800 ms single-state. >1 s (1.26/2.5 s) is a different regime (variance x1.5). Calibration 1 s full-frame darks were all normal-state, so the maps stay valid up to 800 ms. Trigger mode: <= 150 ms (variance +7 % vs free-run at 300 ms).
model: Var[DN] = alpha(S)*S + v_dark(T);  S = signal above dark offset (DN);  alpha(S) from the alpha table (constant alpha is rejected statistically at high charge); v_dark(T) = read_sigma^2 + dark_var_rate*T;  dark shape: empirical residual quantiles
channels_note: ch0=SP1 HCG, ch1=SP1 LCG (same photodiode: equal e-/us), ch2/ch3=SP2 (1/14.5-1/16 sensitivity). Dark range of HDR = ch0 alone. SP1->SP2 switch near 4-8e4 DN (0 dB), alpha_local jumps x16; R switches earlier than G (2x2 decision?)
